name: Magpie Capital
description: Permissionless lending on Solana for humans and AI agents. Agents pay per-call via x402 (SVM exact rail) to screen collateral, take fixed-term SOL loans against 160+ tokens — memecoins, tokenized stocks, gold and silver — and manage repayments programmatically. No accounts, no API keys: discover the price, pay on-chain, borrow.
